spec.description: A custom feed, served through its feed generator, paged by cursor.

feed.description: AT URI of the feed generator record (`app.bsky.feed.generator`).

limit.description: Rows per page. Range [1, 100]; defaults to 50.

cursor.description: Opaque page token from the previous response; omit for the first page.
Token for the next page; absent on the last one.

feed.description: Feed entries, in the generator's order.
